about.title: About MosqueConnect
about.intro: One accurate, community-trusted place for mosque information in Bangladesh.
about.missionBody: Jamat times, Jummah announcements, events and donation drives are usually shared by word of mouth, posters or group chats, and are often incomplete or out of date. MosqueConnect gives every mosque a profile that only approved administrators can edit, so people always find one reliable source.
about.verify1: A mosque administrator applies to claim a mosque and uploads supporting documents.
about.verify2: The documents are pre-screened automatically to help reviewers, then checked by a human super admin.
about.verify3: Only after approval does the mosque get a Verified badge and the right to publish times, announcements, events and campaigns.
about.verify4: Anyone can suggest a correction; the mosque administrators accept or reject it.
about.teamBody: MosqueConnect is built by students of the Department of CSE, Ahsanullah University of Science and Technology (AUST), as part of the CSE 3100 course project.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Times published by a verified mosque administrator are shown as the mosque's own times. If a mosque hasn't published a time, we show a calculated estimate with an Estimated label. You can suggest a correction from any mosque profile.
faq.q2: How do I claim my mosque?
faq.a2: Log in, open your mosque's profile and choose the claim option (or start from <claim>the claim page</claim>). Upload the requested documents; a reviewer will approve or reject the claim and you are notified either way. See the <guide>mosque admin guide</guide>.
faq.q3: Are donations processed through the app?
faq.a3: No. Donations are arranged manually: a campaign shows how to give, you tell the mosque what you gave, and the mosque administrator confirms it. MosqueConnect never holds or moves money.
faq.q4: How do I report something wrong or inappropriate?
faq.a4: Use the Report button on announcements, events, campaigns, reviews and mosque profiles. Reports go to our moderators, who can remove content or contact the author. To tell a mosque about a problem privately, use the feedback option on its profile.
faq.q5: Who can see my phone number?
faq.a5: Your phone number is used to log you in and is not shown publicly. Read the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy> for details.
faq.q6: Does the app need my location?
faq.a6: Only to show mosques near you. You can decline and enter an area manually instead; the choice is stored on your device.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: What we collect, why, and the choices you have.
privacy.collect1: Account: your phone number (for one-time-password login), name and optional profile details.
privacy.collect2: Mosque administrator claims: the documents you upload to prove your role. These may include identity documents such as an NID card.
privacy.collect3: Blood donation: blood group, contact details and responses you choose to share on blood requests.
privacy.collect4: Donations and volunteering: pledges and confirmations you record for campaigns, and volunteer sign-ups.
privacy.collect5: Location: read by your browser only when you allow it, to find nearby mosques. A manually chosen area is kept on your device.
privacy.whyBody: To run the service: sign you in, show nearby mosques, let mosques and communities coordinate, notify you about mosques you follow, review claims and moderate abuse. We do not sell your data or show advertising.
privacy.aiBody: Claim documents are pre-screened by an automated document-analysis service to help reviewers spot problems quickly. The result is only advice: a human super admin makes every approval decision.
privacy.whoBody: Claim documents are visible only to super admins. Blood request contact details are shown only as needed to people who respond. Mosque administrators see the people who register for their events or volunteer with them.
privacy.keepBody: Account data is kept while your account is active. Claim documents are kept only as long as needed to review the claim and keep an audit trail. Time-limited items such as blood requests close automatically.
privacy.choicesBody: You can edit your profile and notification settings, decline location access, and unfollow mosques at any time. To get a copy of your data or have your account and personal data deleted, contact us and we will handle the request.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.intro: By creating an account or using MosqueConnect you agree to these terms.
terms.use1: You must give accurate information and keep your login secure.
terms.use2: Do not post anything false, hateful, unlawful or misleading, and do not impersonate a mosque or its administrators.
terms.use3: Mosque administrators are responsible for the accuracy of what they publish for their mosque.
terms.timesBody: Times and details are provided in good faith by mosques and the community. Estimated times are approximate. Confirm with the mosque when it matters.
terms.donationsBody: MosqueConnect only connects people. Donations and volunteer work are arranged directly between you and the mosque or requester; we do not process payments and are not responsible for the outcome of these arrangements. In an emergency, contact the hospital and emergency services first.
terms.moderationBody: We may remove content, reject claims or suspend accounts that break these terms or harm others.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms; continued use after a change means you accept it. See also the <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.

admin.title: Guide for mosque administrators
admin.intro: From claiming your mosque to running it day to day.
admin.s1Body: Create an account and log in, then open your mosque's profile and start a claim (or go to <claim>the claim page</claim>). If your mosque is not listed, suggest it first.
admin.s2Body: Provide the requested proof that you manage the mosque (for example a committee letter). Use clear, complete scans. The documents are visible only to reviewers.
admin.s3Body: A reviewer approves or rejects the claim. You are notified of the outcome; if it is rejected, the note explains what to fix and you can apply again.
admin.s4Body: After approval open the admin dashboard. Use the sections to update prayer times, publish announcements, create events and campaigns, manage volunteer opportunities, review community suggestions and invite team members.
admin.s5Body: Update times when they change (including Ramadan and Eid). Accept or reject suggested corrections quickly; an up-to-date mosque earns the community's trust.
